# superset_cache_invalidation (Resource)

Drops the cached results of datasets, so their charts query the database again, for example after the data was reloaded. The invalidation runs when the resource is created and whenever `triggers` change. Datasets that do not exist are ignored by Superset. Destroying the resource does nothing.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Drop the cached results of the sales datasets after every reload.
resource "superset_cache_invalidation" "sales" {
  dataset_ids = [superset_dataset.sales.id, superset_dataset.sales_by_region.id]
  triggers = {
    loaded_at = var.last_load
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dataset_ids` (Set of Number) Identifiers of the datasets whose cached results are dropped. A change makes a new resource.

### Optional

- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values whose change runs the invalidation again, for example the date of the last load.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the resource, made of the dataset ids.
